title: Genius Yield | Add support for USDM/CNT trading pairs

ms.promise:
- Server: Update the token pair db schema and domain entities to specify base and quote assets.

- Server: Update `token pairs` list endpoint to return base and quote assets of the pair.

- Server: Update Orderbook endpoint to return bids and asks respecting the trading pair base and quote assets.

- Server: Update Orderbook endpoint to return market price in quote asset specify on the trading pair.

- API spec: Update the api specification to match the server endpoint updates.
ms.criteria:
- Data base schema is updated with appropriate migrations to specify base and quote assets on liquidity pairs.

- The token pairs list endpoint response data structure specifies the pairs base and quote assets.

- The orderbook endpoint returns bids and asks respecting the trading pair base and quote assets.

- The order book endpoint returns the market price in the quote asset specified on the trading pair.

- The api specification is updated to accurately reflect all updates made to endpoint request and response data.

Evidence of Milestone 1 completion

Below is collected evidence for the completion of milestone 1.
Please note that video examples of this feature are available in milestone 2. The feature is also live as of 7th of October at https://app.geniusyield.co/

Evidence of migration scripts

Migration script for adding Trading Pair table

```

-- CreateTable
CREATE TABLE "trading_pair" (
 "trading_pair_id" UUID NOT NULL,
 "created" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
 "updated" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
 "base_asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
 "quote_asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL,

 CONSTRAINT "trading_pair_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("trading_pair_id")
);

-- AddForeignKey
ALTER TABLE "trading_pair" ADD CONSTRAINT "trading_pair_base_asset_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("base_asset_id") REFERENCES "asset"("asset_id") ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE;

-- AddForeignKey
ALTER TABLE "trading_pair" ADD CONSTRAINT "trading_pair_quote_asset_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("quote_asset_id") REFERENCES "asset"("asset_id") ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE;

-- Note: This is written manually to ensure a trading pair cannot be created twice with the same two assets reversed.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX trading_pair_unique_asset_combination ON "trading_pair" (
 LEAST("base_asset_id", "quote_asset_id"),
 GREATEST("base_asset_id", "quote_asset_id")
);

```

Evidence of Final Milestone completion
Note to reviewers
As pointed out by one of our reviewers, the proof of achievement did not clearly state the difference between "final closeout video" and the individual videos demonstrating the features delivered. These are essentially the same as the individual videos demonstrate the entire feature, but are made into individual parts to clearly demonstrate the different features delivered. Creating another closeout video would simply be one long video containing the same material as is currently split up and therefore wouldn't provide any additional proof. I have added some more information in this section to make this clearer, hopefully this sufficiently prove the delivery of this milestone.
Just as a reminder in case there is any confusion for reviewers, this proposal did not make promises to deliver open source code and thus there are no such links.
Please don't hesitate to ask question in the discussion chat if anything is unclear.
Thanks for reviewing!
